meta.name: hivemind-goals
meta.description: Create, track and update team goals + KPIs via the Deeplake virtual filesystem at memory/goal/ and memory/kpi/. Use whenever the user mentions a goal, objective, KPI, target, milestone, or asks to track progress on something measurable. ALSO use when the user says "task", "todo", "work item", "remind me to", "fix X", or any actionable work item — the goal system replaced the legacy `hivemind tasks` CLI and now covers both objectives and tasks.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 创建并追踪团队目标与关键成果
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要管理团队目标、KPI和任务进度
copy.tagline_en: Create and track team goals and key results
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to manage team goals, KPIs, and task progress

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以创建、查看、更新团队目标和关键绩效指标（KPI），所有数据以 Markdown 文件形式存储在 Deeplake 虚拟文件系统中。它还能记录待办任务，并在后续会话中恢复上下文。
howto.when: 当你提到目标、KPI、里程碑、任务、待办事项，或任何可衡量的工作项时触发。也适用于你说“保存这个”、“提醒我”等需要暂存任务的情况。

say.text: 帮我创建一个目标：本月完成5个PR。
say.note: Claude 会生成一个 UUID 并写入目标文件。

say.text: 给这个目标添加一个KPI：PR数量，目标5个。
say.note: Claude 会在对应目录下创建 KPI 文件。

say.text: 记录一下：稍后修复webhook的限流问题。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can create, view, and update team goals and KPIs, stored as Markdown files in the Deeplake virtual filesystem. It can also capture tasks for later and resume them with full context in future sessions.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention a goal, KPI, milestone, task, todo, or any measurable work item. Also triggered when you say "save this for later", "remind me", or similar phrases that park a task.

say_en.text: Create a goal: ship 5 PRs this month.
say_en.note: Claude generates a UUID and writes the goal file.

say_en.text: Add a KPI to this goal: PR count, target 5.
say_en.note: Claude creates a KPI file under the goal's directory.

say_en.text: Capture this: fix webhook rate limiting later.
say_en.note: Claude uses hivemind goal add --agent capture to save context.
